lcc_original: 當挪亞活了六百歲那一年，二月十七日這一天，大深淵的泉源都裂開了，天上的罅隙也敞開了。
notes: UNV {<WAH09001>}{<WH02416>} (implicit חַיֵּי, 'life of') is rendered explicitly in LCC as 活了; per Rule 3, braces dropped and tags attached as normal after the phrase.
LCC's 那一年 is a structural gloss: the two WH08141 instances (construct בִּשְׁנַת + absolute שָׁנָה) are already accounted for by 當 and 歲 respectively; 那一年 left unannotated.
UNV 那<WH02088> (הַזֶּה) maps to LCC 這 — both render the same demonstrative; tag transferred to 這.
LCC 深淵 covers UNV 淵 (WH08415 = תְּהֹום); 深 is LCC's own intensifier, treated as a single lexical unit.
LCC 罅隙 (WH0699) corresponds to UNV 窗戶 (אֲרֻבֹּת, 'sluices/windows'); different Chinese terms, same Hebrew referent.
